rules.requirement: Once per game, at night*, choose a dead player: if they are a Townsfolk, they are resurrected.

a night step whose ability does not resurrect brings no one back (BMR-PROFESSOR-01, BMR-SHABALOTH-01)
a journal recorded while any night step resurrected replays and undoes as written (BMR-PROFESSOR-01, BMR-SHABALOTH-01)
a game whose older ruleset brought a player back on the Tinker's step refuses that now, and undo replays its journal (BMR-PROFESSOR-01, BMR-SHABALOTH-01)
a resurrected player regains a used once-per-game ability (BMR10)
a regurgitated start-knowing player wakes to use the ability again (BMR10)
